data.name: Heather's Haunted House Party
data.detailed_description:
Once the most popular girl in school, Heather wants to throw the best party ever to regain her crown. And as a tribute to her dead bestie, it’s going to be themed: a haunted house. But an uninvited otherworldly guest shows up that could make the phrase, “a party to die for’ very literal. Can Heather plan the party, stay sane and avoid the ‘haunted’ in her haunted house party?

  A visual novel about gossip, grief & ghosts.

This game is still underdevelopment and the features listed here are subject to change

Story Features

  • Play as Heather as she plans the best house party that just happens to be haunted.

  • Help your classmates and their relationships with each other, out of the kindness of your heart (or because it benefits you) or be mean just to be mean.

  • Don't let the guilt of your actions get to you. I'm sure you'll make good choices and they won't give you nightmares.

  • And don't let the neighborhood ghosts get in the way of a good time as you realize your nightmares are very real.

Gameplay Features

  • Visual Novel choice-based gameplay.

    • Recruit classmates to do your bidding

    • Affect the decor, music and food served at the party

    • Make bad decisions and hope they don't come back to haunt you.

  • Minor Point and Click Interactions with other characters, ghosts and the environment.

Additional features

  • One main storyline but many many lives to ruin, including your own. 

  • The game will span approximately 11 days in game, and will most likely have  a 3-5 hour run time for a single play thru, with alternate scenes depending on how the party planning goes.

  • Current plan is for at least 3 main plot endings with several party and side character sub plots with their own choices and endings. Developing the roadmap still as I write and will update this page once the final script is locked in.

Additional Information if you're curious

  • Solo developed by AliceQuinnArt.

  • Began it's life as a game jam game for Spooktober Visual Novel Jam. While some of the writing and the major character and background assets will continue into development, what you see in that game will be restructured and expanded on and parts of it completely rewritten.

  • Based in the world of Unthreaded Memory (Which might get a full length visual novel as well someday)

data.short_description: While trying to plan a party that’s to die for, a high school queen bee finds she has an uninvited guest that is much scarier than your average teenage girl. A Visual Novel about Gossip, Grief and Ghosts.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 or DirectX 11

content_descriptors.notes:
Discussions of the death of a minor, the grieving process and guilt.

Depictions of verbal bullying both actively participated in and directed at the main character and discussion of self harm.

Depicted teenage consumption of tobacco and alcohol abuse. Implied references to illegal drugs in passing but not focused on.

Some fantasy gore and disturbing imagery.
